cryptography.basis: Within each cipher family rank clean ten-example training sets by missing lowercase-letter coverage, then missing case-sensitive coverage; higher is harder. Rotate remainder bands across families to make 100 IDs per level overall.
cryptography.limitations: Information/identifiability proxy, not cipher computational complexity. Same substitution structure within a family; rank ties may cross levels. Applies to default clean paper setting with zero OOD ratio.

list_functions.basis: Weighted AST score: nodes +8*loops +4*conditions +3*calls +2*subscripts +5*comprehensions; sort by (score,ID), five bands of 50.
list_functions.limitations: Representation-dependent rank proxy, not normalized DSL composition depth. Equal scores may cross level boundaries.

instruction_induction.basis: L1 explicit extraction/arithmetic/category rules; L2 lexical exceptions/contextual decisions; L3 sentence relations/rewrites, semantic ratings and translation. Eight fixed task IDs per level.
instruction_induction.limitations: Manual sampling proxy, not measured model difficulty. Different task families have incomparable priors and language expertise.

scan.basis: All official split IDs, ranked by output-length extrapolation gap, unseen compositional jump coverage, missing unique training commands, then ID; four rank bands.
scan.limitations: Heuristic generalization-gap strata, not a single command-depth ordering. Every split still targets the full SCAN interpreter/oracle.

ilp.basis: L1 direct relations/ordered-chain closure; L2 relational joins/general-graph paths/cycles; L3 recursive numerical/list construction. Retain all 19 native configurations: 4/8/7, without dropping or duplicating IDs.
ilp.limitations: Manual mechanism proxy, not a recursion-free/recursive dichotomy or proven minimum rule depth. Includes current author-code unary GraphColoring and scaleup samplers.
